protocol.sequence: B mask validity evaluated first on old exploratory scenes; C task guidance, D balanced selection, E adaptive proposals evaluated sequentially on six new validation scenes; F only after assessing C-E
protocol.independent_scenes: 12 additional mirror images selected by SHA256(phase4b-independent-v1:filename), six validation and six final test, disjoint from earlier 24
protocol.timing: All three timing models retained. Primary spatial ablation fixes the original fitted heuristic lognormal timing. No timing parameter fit in Phase4B.

protocol.limitations: Static TP categorical search, RT-conditioned windows, original source lacks exact event onsets; exploration mode has no human free-viewing validation here

selection_reason: D provisionally selected from initial validation for target acquisition/count NSS and simpler architecture, with worse timing mismatch explicitly retained. Corrected F/N are experimental ablations; no test-based model selection.
validation_note: Revision 2 is an implementation-audit amendment. Some test jobs started before the proto-attribute defect was found, but no held-out outcome scores were inspected before correction. A-E/S numerical paths unaffected; F/N validation and test supersede stale revision1 outputs.
audit_correction: Proto-only candidate attributes now computed from actual location/confidence instead of template. Found in source/trace audit, not from held-out outcome scores. Unchanged A-E/S retained; F/N revalidated and rescored. No held-out outcome scores inspected before correction.
